plain: This story is about a crash said to have happened in 1974 near Coyame, in northern Mexico. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that, according to a document called the DEB report, the CIA, America's foreign spy agency, directed a plan to gather fast-response teams and equipment to go and recover the crashed craft. He admits there is not much supporting evidence, but calls the story disturbing if true. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells it from a report he says leaked in the 1990s. In his version, the object collided with something in mid-air, the whole Mexican team that reached it ended up dead, and US forces flew the object out. If true, it would mean the US secretly crossed a border to retrieve an unknown craft.
